innovation.summary: Incoherence is an innovative single-player FPS that combines survival, horror, comedy, and retro-futurism elements. It utilizes the Quake 2 RTX engine to leverage ray-tracing technology for realistic lighting and reflections, enhancing the immersive experience within its unique game world.
